lgsd-method.text: How was this calculated? On a price of £1,600,000: 7% on the first £125,000 (£8,750), 9% on the part from £125,000 to £250,000 (£11,250), 12% on the part from £250,000 to £925,000 (£81,000), 17% on the part from £925,000 to £1,500,000 (£97,750), 19% on the part from £1,500,000 to £1,600,000 (£19,000). Total £217,750, rounded down to the pound. Uses the residential rates for England and Northern Ireland from 1 April 2025: 0% up to £125,000, 2% from £125,001 to £250,000, 5% to £925,000, 10% to £1.5 million and 12% above. First-time buyers pay nothing up to £300,000 and 5% from £300,001 to £500,000; above £500,000 the standard rates apply. An additional property costing £40,000 or more pays 5% more on every band, and non-UK residents pay 2% more. The total is rounded down to the pound. Scotland has Land and Buildings Transaction Tax and Wales has Land Transaction Tax instead.
